title: Site pages and navigation
description: The nine pages of the multi-page site, and the order they appear in the nav. Kept as data rather than hardcoded in the nav generator so adding a page is a content edit, and so the desktop nav, the More menu and the mobile drawer can never list different things.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

drawer_note.description: Disclaimer shown at the foot of the mobile drawer.

pages.description: NAV ORDER IS ARRAY ORDER, within each group.

id.description: Stable key. This is what generateNav(activePage) is passed, and what marks the current item.

label.description: Nav text. Kept short — the desktop bar holds five of these plus a menu.

url.description: Href used in links. Extensionless, so Netlify serves issues.html at /issues; see the redirect note in netlify.toml.

file.description: Output filename written to the publish root.

icon.description: Emoji shown in the mobile drawer, and in the More menu. The desktop bar stays text-only.

group.description: 'primary' sits directly in the desktop bar; 'more' sits behind the More menu. The mobile drawer ignores this and lists everything.

badge.description: Time-limited flag beside the label, e.g. the election date.

until.description: ISO date after which the badge stops showing. The build fails if this disagrees with elections.election_date, so the two cannot drift.
